page.name: PortfolioManagement
page.summary: The most complex page in the portal. A full portfolio optimization workbench with 5 tabs (Alpha, Sector, Model, Trade, History). Receives pre-calculated optimization data from the opal-pm-optimization-loader Lambda (503 securities x 33 factors), supports inline weight editing via an AG Grid (33 columns), dual 60-second auto-save (legacy trade-based and new optimization-state), file uploads via presigned S3 URLs, version/export history, and an Export-and-Submit flow that creates a PENDING_APPROVAL record in TradeSubmission.

tabs.tab: Factor attribution table (alpha factors). Group filtering, search, 3-state sort (canonical/asc/desc). Separate "Total Alpha" row. Read-only display.

Sector allocation table with constraint violations (min/max bounds highlighted red). Computes final/optimized weights bottom-up from security data. 3-state sortable. Constraint validation via useConstraintValidation hook.
Model coefficients table with toggle between By Factor (34 factors) and By Group (15 groups) views. Read-only, 3-state sortable.

Main portfolio grid (PortfolioGrid.tsx). 33 columns with frozen left pane (ticker/name/economy) and scrollable pane (weights/factors/risk/trade). Inline editing: optimizedWeight and finalTrade. Multi-select for bulk operations, fullscreen toggle, security lookup, version history modal, export modal.
Version history. Shows export metadata (exported_at, uploaded_by, trades_count, overrides_count), download buttons for Trade CSV, and submission tracking links per version.

page.name: TradeSubmission
page.summary: The downstream approval and execution portal for trade orders. Receives submissions created either manually (via SubmitTab form or Excel/CSV file upload) or automatically from PortfolioManagement's Export-and-Submit flow. Four tabs model the full trade lifecycle: Submit (initiate), Approvals (PENDING_APPROVAL queue, 15s refetch), Execution (APPROVED queue, 20s refetch), History (COMPLETE/REJECTED, paginated 20/page). All workflow actions (approve, reject, execute) flow through a single /api/general/trades/workflow endpoint. Three backend Lambdas: trade-submission-handler, trade-workflow-handler, trade-dashboard-api.

tabs.tab: New trade submission form. FileUploadZone (Excel/CSV parse via services/fileParser.ts), ConsolidatedTradePanel (fund, dates, brokerage destination, SecuritiesTable), AttestationsCard (4 required checkboxes), SubmitButtonRow. Ticker autocomplete via searchIdentifierCache (2-char minimum), identifier batch-save after successful submission.

Pending trades (PENDING_APPROVAL status). Alert banner when items present. TradeCard grid with approve/reject/view/download actions. Modals: ApproveModal, RejectModal, TradeDetailsModal. useApprovals hook refetches every 15s.
Approved trades (APPROVED status). Success banner when items present. TradeCards with execute/view/download actions. ExecuteModal shows brokerage destination. Refetches every 20s.

Completed and rejected trades. View mode toggle (My Submissions vs All Trades). Status filter (Complete/Rejected). Pagination: 20 items/page, resets to page 1 on filter/mode change. TradeCards with view/download actions.

page.trade_lifecycle: PENDING_APPROVAL → (approveSubmission) → APPROVED → (executeSubmission) → EXECUTED → COMPLETE PENDING_APPROVAL → (rejectSubmission) → REJECTED APPROVED → (rejectSubmission) → REJECTED All state transitions: POST /api/general/trades/workflow with action: approve|reject|execute|complete

page.name: DataRefresh
page.summary: Admin/ops-only page (requires Dev userType) for triggering full portal data refreshes. Users upload PKL files (alpha.pkl, model.pkl) and optionally a manifest.json, then trigger the Yang pipeline via AWS Step Functions. Pipeline status is polled every 3 seconds until a terminal state. History tab shows past executions with rollback capability. CurrentStatePanel reads the live manifest.json to show data freshness (Fresh/Aging/Stale). All backend calls go through portal-proxy.ts using apiRequest (scoped/dev-gated routes).

tabs.tab: FileDropZone (drag-and-drop, manifest.json auto-detection), ManifestPreview (file presence checks, missing file warnings, generators-to-run list), UploadProgress (per-file XHR progress), PipelineProgress (grouped Step Functions steps with auto-expand on active step), CurrentStatePanel (live manifest.json showing data_as_of per source).
Execution history table (status, data_as_of, files_processed, duration, triggered_by). Rollback button per row triggers rollbackDataRefresh. Informational panel explains rollback mechanics.

primary_data_hook.endpoint: POST /api/scoped/data-refresh/trigger → returns { executionId }; then GET /api/scoped/data-refresh/status/{executionId} polled every 3s
primary_data_hook.backend: portal-proxy.ts apiRequest (scoped, dev-userType required); ultimately invokes Yang pipeline via Step Functions

page.manifest_format: manifest.json parsed in FileDropZone. Fields: files[] with type (data_pkl|model_pkl|cma_excel|peer_excel|attribution_excel|regression_csv), filename, size, status. Optional: strategy, asOfDate. Missing file detection shows UX warnings.
page.data_freshness: CurrentStatePanel fetches /api/general/json/latest/manifest.json using Bearer token from localStorage (useQuery with caching). Displays generated_at, pipeline_execution_id, per-source data_as_of/updated_at. Staleness categories: Fresh / Aging / Stale based on age.

intra_pod_workflow.name: PM-to-TradeSubmission Export Bridge
intra_pod_workflow.description: The primary operational workflow of this pod. PM user completes optimization, reviews the Trade tab, then triggers Export-and-Submit from ExportModal (TradeTab). This calls exportAndSubmit() in portfolio.ts (POST /api/private/portfolio/export-and-submit), which generates the Vident Trade CSV, uploads it to S3, and writes a PENDING_APPROVAL TradeSubmission record to DynamoDB. The resulting submissionId is stored in VersionMetadata.submissionId (listVersions response) and appears in TradeSubmission's Approvals tab via getPendingApprovals() (15s refetch). History tab in PM shows each version's submissionId as a navigation link to TradeSubmission.

external_dependency.name: DataRefresh invokes Yang Pipeline

This pipeline regenerates the JSON data consumed by PortfolioAnalytics pod pages (Positioning, Attribution, FactorTilts, Valuation, Macroeconomics, Correlation). Cross-pod operational dependency: DataRefresh is the admin trigger for data that feeds the entire PortfolioAnalytics pod.

The highest risk area is PortfolioManagement: 9 TODO stubs in calculation hooks (predictedBeta, totalRisk, assetSelection, commonFactor, AUM sourcing) leave summary stats partially incomplete. The getSecurityDetails backend endpoint is not yet deployed (console.warn logged). Bulk edit selection from AG Grid is stubbed. DataRefresh and TradeSubmission are clean with only minor documentation alignment issues.

Risk calculation stubs (predictedBeta, totalRisk) mean the summary panel does not show accurate live metrics.
pod_health.operational_note: DataRefresh is Dev-userType gated (scoped API). Regular portal users cannot trigger it. TradeSubmission uses publicApiRequest — no JWT scope — trades rely on email-based identity (no RBAC enforcement at the API level beyond Lambda business logic).
